alt.en: Two context IDs 0,1 retrieve embedding rows 1,0 and 0,1, shape 1 by 2 by 2. Concatenation yields 1,0,0,1. A supplied hidden matrix yields 1,1. Output logits are 0,0,ln 3,0; target 750 receives probability one half and loss ln 2.
alt.zh-hans: 两个上下文 ID 0、1 查得向量 1、0 与 0、1，形状为 1×2×2。拼接得到 1、0、0、1，经过给定隐藏矩阵得到 1、1。输出分数为 0、0、ln 3、0；目标 750 的概率为二分之一，损失为 ln 2。

caption.en: Figure 10.1 — A fixed window preserves the order of its two rows by concatenation.
caption.zh-hans: 图 10.1 — 固定窗口通过拼接，保留其中两行的先后顺序。

credit.en: Original hand-assigned snapshot, CC BY-SA 4.0; separate from the measured trained model.
credit.zh-hans: 本书原创手工参数快照，CC BY-SA 4.0；与实测训练模型分开记录。

flow.en: Reversing the context changes this concatenation, even though its average would be unchanged.
flow.zh-hans: 调换上下文顺序会改变拼接结果，即使平均向量不变。

flow.en: The full model can update E, H, U and biases through the same loss. The paper values are supplied, not learned.
flow.zh-hans: 完整模型可以用同一个损失更新 E、H、U 和偏置；本图数值由作者给定，并非训练所得。
